components.text:
The Yawning of the Void (internally: Yawning Void Ritual) voids items matching a filter from a linked chest, useful for automatically clearing out unwanted overflow items from a processing line. Tier 0, costs $(blood)5,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.
To set a filter, place any form of Item Filter into the linked chest. The ritual will only use the first filter it finds, but will accept Standard, Tag, and Mod Item Filters.
